stemMd: Why did the operator want several months of records?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A longer record automatically removes every confounding factor.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Only the final trip of a year can be measured.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The coating cannot affect drag at all.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The first month’s records were necessarily forged.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The coating’s performance might change with use.

explanationMd: The passage distinguishes initial condition from prolonged-use performance. Longer observation can reveal whether an early benefit persists. Duration alone does not replace comparable operating conditions.

distractorRationale.d: No dishonesty in the records is established.
distractorRationale.a: Load and route still need attention.
distractorRationale.c: The passage allows a plausible benefit.
